scope: Engine-level DFlash2 verification speedup for fafstmobel on one RTX 5090 (32 GB), fourth kernel pass. Round time is the controlled metric; tokens/s also depends on draft acceptance. The second- through fourth-pass changes are bit-exact, so b2215c4 and the new revision accept identical drafts; b4e8ed4 accepts slightly different drafts because the first pass changed attention numerics.
hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 32 GB; desktop GPU workloads active during measurement; the board ran at its 575 W power limit, so every build's absolute round time is about 8.5% above the third-pass record's
model: fafstmobel NInfer v3 artifact; DFlash2 with 15 draft tokens; optimized proposal head (--lm-head-draft); K8V4 KV cache

revisions.fourth_pass: 4994a0c (with 3dc5297, 181fe20, 979cc2c, b7e1a8b: fused query/key RMSNorm-RoPE, the K8V4 verify query prepared once per block, warp-merged proposal top-k groups and a staged selector walk, L2 discards of consumed K8V4 split numerators, and a mask-free softmax path for unmasked K8V4 key tiles)

product_benchmark.tool: ninfer_bench --spec dflash2 --draft-tokens 15 --lm-head-draft --kv-dtype k8v4 --warmup 1 -r 2; greedy; 256 generated tokens
product_benchmark.protocol: the three binaries alternate for four runs (8K, 32K) or three runs (131K); median of runs
